gen-gf-gugi-gf-pathway-extreme: Gugi stands tall, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals and its cut-open terminals letting each counter flow outward. Pathway Extreme answers with stubby ascenders and a big x-height, making the plain sans text feel compact and friendly.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-preahvihear: Gugi's lowercase climbs almost to the capital line. Its curves match the stems exactly, a compass-drawn consistency, while Preahvihear counters with a lofty x-height and a wide open mouth.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-stack-sans-headline: Goldman spreads its letters wide with generous clearance, and its round forms look like open parentheses held up high. Stack Sans Headline keeps a plain sans steadiness.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-stack-sans-notch: Chunky, wide-awake lettering with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Stack Sans Notch brings open curves you can see right into, plus a big-bodied feel in every lowercase word, and that openness is where the pair is strongest.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-prompt: Tall, bold, and quietly level, with no accents of weight anywhere. And Prompt, a plain sans with an oversized look to its small letters and easy open apertures, is where the pair is strongest.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmong: Eater pairs hairline-free thin strokes with moderately weighty stems, which gives it a dark, aggressive bite. Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong, a plain sans with a high-set x-height and rounds that gap open, is the pair's steadiest quality.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Audiowide sets its tall lowercase like tiles with wide grout lines, futuristic and free of any thick-thin shift. Noto Sans Avestan brings a plain sans with a pronounced x-height and curve tips that never touch.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-vend-sans: Expressive from the first glance, Autour One has a clear channel leading into each round letter. Vend Sans, a plain sans drawn with a ruler-straight line, brings wide unclosed terminals and an x-height filling the line.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-stack-sans-text: Goldman sets wide, round letters like open parentheses. Stack Sans Text, a plain sans with a marker-like constant line and curve endings kept well apart, makes a long passage feel spacious and easy to follow, with big-bodied lowercase moving steadily along.
